notes.title: Announcing the free Chompy Chomp Chomp Party Demo - Join the Party Today!
notes.notes:
Attention all Chompy Chomp Chomp players!

We have some exciting news to share with you. We've just released a brand-new free demo for Chompy Chomp Chomp Party, the ultimate evolution of the Chompy Chomp Chomp series! Get ready for a wild party experience like never before.

In this demo, you'll have unlimited access to the Chase and Chomp mode, now enhanced for up to 8 players. Gather your friends or family and immerse yourselves in the chaotic multiplayer fun. Take on the challenge of the disco-themed levels and see who can outwit and out-chomp their opponents!

But that's not all! Chompy Chomp Chomp Party introduces a host of exciting new features, including stackable power-ups, where you can store up to 3 power-ups and strategically choose the perfect moment to unleash them. We've also added the incredible Vortex power-up, allowing you to teleport your opponents to new locations and shake up the game in unexpected ways!

As loyal players of the original Chompy Chomp Chomp, we wanted to give you the first taste of this new party extravaganza. So head over to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1479850/Chompy_Chomp_Chomp_Party]the Chompy Chomp Chomp Party store page[/url] and download the free demo today. We can't wait to hear your thoughts and see you embrace the party madness!

Check out the new trailer...

[previewyoutube=u6ZBzk_FaW0;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm. Stay tuned for more exciting updates and announcements on the Chompy Chomp Chomp Party journey. Let the chomping begin!

Happy chomping,
Woody

notes.title: Chompy Chomp Chomp Party out now!
notes.notes:
Hi Chompy Chomp Chomp players,

I have released Chompy Chomp Chomp Party today, 17th November 2022, on Nintendo Switch and Steam. 

The aim is to create games that bring people together through joy and play, and to deepen the conversation around ethical gaming, particularly for families and friendship groups. I made Chompy Chomp Chomp Party with my wife and kids in the shed at the bottom of my garden, for us to play together.

If you loved the original, come play the new game. Chompy Chomp Chomp Party is a simple, inclusive, fresh and colourful party game sure to bring pure and intense fun to your living room.  I have been working on it on and off for the past 8 years while I lived life, had a family and earned money through other means. There have been times when it felt like this day would never come, but it has! 

Designed specifically for bursts of intense fun with your friends and family. Play 6 modes (with more to come via DLC) over 28 arenas and with an infinite level generator, no two games will ever be the same.

	• Up to 8 players local multiplayer
	• 6 game modes (plus more with DLC)
	• 28 arenas (plus more with DLC)
	• Level generator
	• Thumping party soundtrack by Team Doyobi
	• Supports Remote Play Together for online play 

It has an updated version of Chase and Chomp (Battle) mode from Chompy Chomp Chomp plus 5 new modes. Spooky Party DLC is available on launch day which includes the Ghost game mode plus an additional 4 graveyard themed arenas. More DLC will be coming soon and it is my intention to update the game much more than I could with the original. 

So get ready to have your own Chompy Chomp Chomp Party. Purchase the game here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1479850/Chompy_Chomp_Chomp_Party/
